newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 15.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories:
NEW YORK - AT&T Corp. has decided to give all 127,000 of its employees a paid day off for volunteer work over the next year.
WASHINGTON - District Texaco franchises so far feeling no effects from civil rights leader Jesse Jackson's call for a boycott of the company's products.

WASHINGTON - The Equal Employment Opportunity Commission advised the judge and parties in the Texaco race discrimination suit that it will meet with Texaco lawyers next week to attempt to resolve the allegations.
WASHINGTON - Six months after a ValuJet DC-9 crashed in flames and killed all 110 people on board, the government moved to require fire detection and suppression systems in airline cargo holds.
